findings.message: Cancellation during a ping is swallowed as an offline result, allowing a canceled monitoring check to complete successfully. The new SendPingAsync call receives cancellationToken, but its OperationCanceledException reaches catch (Exception) at line 184, which logs a warning and returns false. If the device was already offline, CheckDeviceAsync takes the unchanged-status branch without another cancellation-aware operation, so CheckAllDevicesAsync can return successfully instead of propagating cancellation.

The tests do not verify the new ping cancellation or one-time platform warning behavior. The diff changes only Dockerfile and DeviceMonitoringService.cs. The existing cancellation test throws from GetAllPcDevicesAsync before any ping occurs, while the loopback test permits zero updates with Times.AtMostOnce; neither exercises cancellation during SendPingAsync or the new PlatformNotSupportedException handler.
